name: Tra'kad-class transport
description: The Tra'kad was a Mandalorian Protector starship introduced in 40 ABY, meant to complement the Bes'uliik. It was a slow, heavily-armored ship described as a "flying tank," the main uses of which were in assault, troop insertion and extraction, and fire support.

data.name: Tra'kad-class transport
data.role: Troop transport and insertion, assault, fire support
